entries.3f9cea7ea8039452: As its basic management policy, it aims to meet the trust and expectations of consumers, business partners, local communities and shareholders through the research, production and sale of mushrooms, which are healthy foods. Under its management vision, 'Use mushrooms to deliver health and expand markets and consumption as our mission,' it promotes 'Kinoko de kinkatsu,' built on three pillars of health, beauty and sports, and states that it will push forward with raising awareness of its original variety Shimofuri hiratake, as well as new customer development and area strategies set out in its new medium-term management plan.

entries.f1d88a3cb9cdc078: It handles everything from developing new varieties to cultivation and sales, and continues variety improvement and cultivation technology development centered on the Kinoko Sogo Kenkyusho.
